entities.name: Haiduk Resistance & Chiprovtsi Uprising
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Haiduks (outlaw-rebels) became symbols of Bulgarian resistance. The Chiprovtsi Uprising (1688), inspired by Habsburg victories, was crushed, resulting in the destruction of the Catholic Bulgarian community and mass exile.
